diagram.manim_description: Draw a flat 2D route strip on a plain white (BG) 1920 by 1080 canvas, to scale at 1400 px for 576 km. Draw one horizontal INK line, 3 px thick, at y = 560 from x = 260 to x = 1660. Draw three stop markers on the line, each a circle of radius 18 px with BG fill and a 3 px INK outline: Mumbai at x = 260, Ratnagiri at x = 1096 (260 + 1400 x 344 / 576, rounded), Goa at x = 1660. Write each place name in INK sans-serif, 48 px, centred above its marker with the text centre at y = 480: 'Mumbai', 'Ratnagiri', 'Goa'. Above the line draw a square bracket in INK, 3 px thick: a horizontal segment at y = 380 from x = 260 to x = 1660 with a 30 px tick down at each end (y = 380 to y = 410); write '576 km' in INK, 52 px, centred at x = 960, y = 330. Below the line draw two square brackets, 3 px thick, each a horizontal segment at y = 650 with a 30 px tick up at each end (y = 650 to y = 620): the first in SET_A from x = 260 to x = 1088, the second in SET_B from x = 1104 to x = 1660. Write '344 km' in INK, 52 px, centred at x = 674, y = 720, and '232 km' in INK, 52 px, centred at x = 1382, y = 720. Draw nothing else: no sea, coastline, roads, cyclists, arrows, tick numbers, day counts or per-day distances.
must_not_show: the per-day distances 48 km or 58 km, the 12 days, the 4 days or the rest day
a geographic map, sea, coastline, roads, cyclist or building icons
numbers on the line itself (no 0, 344 or 576 as tick labels)
accuracy_checks: 344 + 232 = 576, so the two lower brackets together span the same distance as the 576 km bracket
Ratnagiri x = 260 + 1400 x 344 / 576 = 1096 (+/- 1 px), Goa x = 1660, so Mumbai-Ratnagiri is 836 px and Ratnagiri-Goa is 564 px (ratio 344 : 232)
the upper bracket runs exactly from the Mumbai marker to the Goa marker; the lower brackets stop 8 px short of the Ratnagiri x on each side
exactly three place names and exactly three distance labels are drawn
diagram.alt_text: A straight route from Mumbai on the left through Ratnagiri to Goa on the right, marked 344 km from Mumbai to Ratnagiri, 232 km from Ratnagiri to Goa and 576 km from Mumbai to Goa.
diagram.render_note: Schematic route strip made from the book's map on p.15 (Mumbai at the top of the coast, Ratnagiri a little over half way down, Goa at the bottom). A real map cannot be drawn faithfully (NOT_RENDERABLE), so the coast is laid flat from left to right and only what the question needs is kept: the three place names and the three printed distances (the book writes 344Km, 232Km, 576Km; the LP writes km). Positions are to scale. The map's colours (blue, red, purple arrows) are replaced by the style tokens SET_A and SET_B for the two legs. Solution side (C142) is optional and not drawn, so there is no derived diagram.
